description: Manage InnoSage Draft pages and hosted Secret Shares using the @innosage/draft-cli. Read public Draft preview feedback via bounded first-party HTTPS GET requests. Use this skill for `draft`, `draft page ...`, `draft secret ...`, and `draft auth ...`. Prefer JSON Workspace page operations anchored by workspace status/path metadata. Do not use this skill when "draft" is only a verb or when the task is a generic local-file writing task unrelated to Draft CLI.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
